_: One key, one fingerprint, agreed by every language that touches it. RFC 7638 hashes a canonical JSON object with the required members in lexicographic order and no whitespace; get that wrong in one implementation and a correct signature is refused for no visible reason, which is the least diagnosable failure this design can produce. Swift asserts it in DeviceKeyTests; the private service asserts it in test/verify.test.ts. Generated once with jose and never regenerated: a vector that moves with the code it checks is not a vector.
